t: MOTOR CARRIER SAFETY IMPROVEMENT: EMPLOYMENT STATUS

l: (1) "Motor carrier" has the meaning assigned by Section 643.001.
(A) device, equipment, software, or technology that is intended and primarily used to improve or facilitate:
(i) compliance with traffic safety or motor carrier safety laws;
(iii) safety of an operator of a motor vehicle; and
(iv) safety of third-party users of public roadways; or
(B) procedure, training, policy, program, or operational practice related to any device, equipment, software, or technology described by Paragraph (A).

The deployment, implementation, or use of a motor carrier safety improvement by or as required by a motor carrier or a related entity, including through contract, may not be considered when determining whether the operator of a motor vehicle is an employee or joint employee of the motor carrier or an independent contractor for purposes of state law.
